# Owen Graphite

Owen Graphite is a graphite-toned theme with Light, Dark and Report variants, described as optimized for Korean reports, technical documents and wikis, with glass-style UI and visual sync between Live Preview and Reading View. It targets A3-friendly PDF export with page-splitting fixes for callouts, tables, Mermaid, code and images, and it offers 38 Style Settings alongside CJK and OS dark-mode adjustments.

![Owen Graphite screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/towishy/Owen-Graphite/HEAD/screenshots/light.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Owen Graphite"
    author: "Owen lee"
    repo:   "towishy/Owen-Graphite"
    slug:   "owen-graphite"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/owen-graphite"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/towishy/Owen-Graphite"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/towishy/Owen-Graphite/HEAD/screenshots/light.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a graphite-toned Light/Dark/Report theme optimized for Korean reports, technical documents, and wikis with glass-style UI and Live Preview Reading View visual sync. Export A3-friendly PDFs with automatic page-splitting fixes for callouts, tables, Mermaid, code and images, and fine-tune visuals with 38 Style Settings plus CJK and OS dark-mode adjustments."
}
```
